REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Authority, attestation, replay binding, RCA, refactor review, and token-threshold rules are directionally sound. However, the hash-pinned package’s mandatory deterministic fixture gate is incomplete: its test driver references multiple fixtures absent from the exact package, so schema/fixture checks cannot pass.
FINDING: high|scripts/test_factory_ng_contracts.py|The test references five absent fixtures, beginning with invalid-provenance-ordinary-unsigned-review.json|A high-impact amendment must remain proposed until complete deterministic schema/fixture gates pass; this gate instead terminates on missing input.
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Add and hash-pin every referenced fixture, or remove the dangling references and supply equivalent complete counterexamples; then rerun the full contract gate.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: Invoke scripts/test_factory_ng_contracts.py using only this exact package; loading invalid-provenance-ordinary-unsigned-review.json raises FileNotFoundError before the gate can pass.
